ACRO.comment: manual body-frame angular rate with manual throttle

ALT_HOLD.comment: manual airframe angle with automatic throttle

AUTO.comment: fully automatic waypoint control using mission commands

AUTOTUNE.comment: automatically tune the vehicle's roll and pitch gains

AUTO_RTL.comment: Auto RTL, this is not a true mode, AUTO will report as this mode if entered to perform a DO_LAND_START Landing sequence

AVOID_ADSB.comment: automatic avoidance of obstacles in the macro scale - e.g. full-sized aircraft

BRAKE.comment: full-brake using inertial/GPS system, no pilot input

CIRCLE.comment: automatic circular flight with automatic throttle

DRIFT.comment: semi-autonomous position, yaw and throttle control

FLIP.comment: automatically flip the vehicle on the roll axis

FLOWHOLD.comment: FLOWHOLD holds position with optical flow without rangefinder

FOLLOW.comment: follow attempts to follow another vehicle or ground station

GUIDED.comment: fully automatic fly to coordinate or fly at velocity/direction using GCS immediate commands

GUIDED_NOGPS.comment: guided mode but only accepts attitude and altitude

LAND.comment: automatic landing with horizontal position control

LOITER.comment: automatic horizontal acceleration with automatic throttle

POSHOLD.comment: automatic position hold with manual override, with automatic throttle

SMART_RTL.comment: SMART_RTL returns to home by retracing its steps

SPORT.comment: manual earth-frame angular rate control with manual throttle

STABILIZE.comment: manual airframe angle with manual throttle

SYSTEMID.comment: System ID mode produces automated system identification signals in the controllers

THROW.comment: throw to launch mode using inertial/GPS system, no pilot input

ZIGZAG.comment: ZIGZAG mode is able to fly in a zigzag manner with predefined point A and point B
